title: Calling Foreign Functions
goal: Learn how to declare external C functions with unsafe extern blocks.

sections.text: Rust code can call functions written in C using `extern "C"` blocks.

sections.caption: C functions without safety preconditions are declared safe.

sections.text: Functions taking pointers can cause undefined behavior if given invalid inputs.

sections.caption: Functions with preconditions must be marked unsafe.

sections.text: The compiler cannot inspect foreign code. You must match C function signatures accurately.

explanation: Learn how to declare external C functions with unsafe extern blocks.
